albula-julier-runde.description: From St. Moritz down the Engadine to La Punt, over the Albula Pass to Bergün and Filisur, to Tiefencastel and through the Surses via Savognin and Bivio up the Julier and back to St. Moritz via Silvaplana.
albula-julier-runde.note: The old road via Salouf and Cunter avoids the Crap Ses tunnel below Savognin.

alpenbrevet-silbertour.description: From Andermatt over the Gotthard to Airolo, over the Nufenen to Ulrichen, through the Goms to Gletsch and back to Andermatt over the Furka. The platinum route adds the Susten, Grimsel, Lukmanier and Oberalp (267 km).
alpenbrevet-silbertour.note: Event in early September, starting and finishing in Andermatt; over the Gotthard on the main road, not the Tremola.

andermatt-drei-paesse-runde.description: Furka – Grimsel – Susten, back through the Schöllenen gorge.

arlberg-giro.description: From St. Anton over the Arlberg into the Klostertal and to Bludenz, through the Montafon up the Silvretta High Alpine Road, over the Bielerhöhe into the Paznaun and back to St. Anton through the Stanzertal.
arlberg-giro.note: Event in early August; the Silvretta is a toll road.

ballino-runde.description: From Riva via Tenno and the Lago di Tenno up to the Passo del Ballino, via Fiavè and Ponte Arche into the Sarca valley and back to the lake via Sarche and Arco.
ballino-runde.note: Occasional snow at the top of the Ballino in winter.

ballons-runde.description: From Thann over the Hundsruck into the Doller valley, from Sewen up the Ballon d'Alsace, down to Saint-Maurice and back through the Thur valley over the Col de Bussang.
ballons-runde.note: Over Bussang on the N66 with lorry traffic; the rest is quiet.

baronnies-runde.description: From Buis-les-Baronnies via Saint-Auban up to the Col de Perty, through Laborel over the Col de Saint-Jean, via Séderon and over the Col de Macuègne to Montbrun, beneath the north face of the Ventoux via Brantes up to the Col de Fontaube and back to Buis via Eygaliers.
baronnies-runde.note: Briefly closed after snowfall on the Perty.

cingles-du-mont-ventoux.description: All three sides of Mont Ventoux in one day: up from Bédoin, down to Malaucène and up again, down past Chalet Reynard to Sault and up a third time from there, back to Bédoin.
cingles-du-mont-ventoux.note: A permanent challenge of the Club des Cinglés with a stamp card, in any order; the club advises not to ride before April or after October. Length and climb are the sum of the three sides, not an official figure.

dolomitenradrundfahrt-lienz.description: From Lienz down the Drau valley to Oberdrauburg, over the Gailbergsattel to Kötschach-Mauthen, through the Lesachtal via Maria Luggau and Obertilliach up to the Kartitscher Sattel and back through the Puster valley to Lienz.
dolomitenradrundfahrt-lienz.note: Austria's oldest cycling marathon, on the same loop since 1951, from Lienz in mid-June. Two low saddles with the long ups and downs of the Lesachtal in between.

dreilaendergiro.description: From Nauders over the Reschen Pass into the Vinschgau, from Prad up the Stelvio, over the Umbrail into the Val Müstair, over the Ofen Pass to Zernez and down the Lower Engadine via Martina and the Norbertshöhe back to Nauders.
dreilaendergiro.note: Event in late June, through Austria, Italy and Switzerland; Tirol's tourist board gives 3,300 m.

dreipaesse-rundfahrt-thusis.description: From Thusis through the Via Mala and the Schams to Splügen, over the Splügen Pass to Chiavenna, through the Bregaglia up the Maloja, via Silvaplana up the Julier and back to Thusis via Bivio, Savognin and Tiefencastel.
dreipaesse-rundfahrt-thusis.note: The Schin road between Tiefencastel and Thusis is busy; the Rhaetian Railway is the alternative.

engadiner-radmarathon.description: From Zernez over the Flüela Pass to Davos, through the Landwasser valley to Filisur and Bergün, over the Albula Pass to La Punt and down the Engadine back to Zernez.
engadiner-radmarathon.note: Event in early July, held over three days since 2026; the former 211 km course is no longer ridden.

etape-du-tour-2024.description: From Nice over the Col de Nice and the Col de Braus to Sospel, up the Turini via Moulinet, down the Vésubie to Saint-Martin-Vésubie, over the Col Saint-Martin at La Colmiane into the Tinée and from Saint-Sauveur up to the finish on the Col de la Couillole.
etape-du-tour-2024.note: Held on 7 July 2024 on closed roads ahead of the Tour stage; finish on the Couillole.

etape-du-tour-2025.description: From Albertville via Ugine up the côte of Héry-sur-Ugine, over the Col des Saisies to Beaufort, from Arêches up the Col du Pré, past the Lac de Roselend over the Cormet de Roselend, down through Les Chapieux to Bourg-Saint-Maurice and from Aime up to the finish at La Plagne.
etape-du-tour-2025.note: Held on 20 July 2025 on closed roads with 16,000 riders; the pro stage five days later was cut short without the Saisies, the Étape rode the full course.

etape-du-tour-2026.description: From Bourg d'Oisans via Allemond over the Col de la Croix de Fer and down to Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne, up the Télégraphe and the Galibier, down over the Lautaret and past La Grave to Mizoën, and over the Col de Sarenne to the finish at Alpe d'Huez, from the back rather than up the 21 hairpins.
etape-du-tour-2026.note: Held on 19 July 2026 on closed roads, six days before the Tour stage; finish at Alpe d'Huez via the Sarenne.

gavia-mortirolo-runde.description: Bormio – Gavia – Ponte di Legno – Edolo – Mortirolo from Monno – Mazzo – Bormio.

grappa-runde.description: From Bassano via Semonzo up to the Monte Grappa and down via Possagno, back to Bassano along the foot of the mountain – up the classic side, down the quiet one.
grappa-runde.note: Temporarily closed at the top after snowfall.

grosse-scheidegg-runde.description: From Meiringen through the Rosenlaui valley over the Grosse Scheidegg to Grindelwald, down to Interlaken and back to Meiringen along the south shore of Lake Brienz via Iseltwald and Brienz.
grosse-scheidegg-runde.note: The Grosse Scheidegg is open only to the postbus and to bicycles.

hochvogesen-runde.description: From Munster to the Schlucht, along the Route des Crêtes over the Hohneck and the Markstein to the Grand Ballon, and back into the Munster valley over the Platzerwasel.
hochvogesen-runde.note: The crest road is closed roughly mid-November to mid-April; the detour from the Markstein to the Grand Ballon is ridden there and back.

kaernten-radmarathon.description: From Bad Kleinkirchheim via Ebene Reichenau up the Nockalm Road, over the Schiestlscharte and the Eisentalhöhe to Innerkrems, down to Gmünd and along Lake Millstatt via Radenthein back to Bad Kleinkirchheim.
kaernten-radmarathon.note: Event in early June; the Nockalm Road is a toll road, and since 2026 the stretch between Gmünd and Dellach takes a new line.

klausen-pragel-runde.description: From Glarus through the Klöntal over the Pragel into the Muota valley, via Schwyz to Brunnen, along Lake Uri to Flüelen and Altdorf, over the Klausen into Glarus and back via Linthal.
klausen-pragel-runde.note: Bicycles have been banned from the Axen road between Brunnen and Sisikon since 2023; a shuttle bus runs hourly. The Pragel is closed to cars on Sundays and public holidays.

la-fausto-coppi.description: From Cuneo via Busca and Venasca into the Varaita valley, over the Colle di Sampeyre into the Maira valley, from Ponte Marmora up the Colle d'Esischie and on to the Colle Fauniera, down to Demonte, over the Madonna del Colletto to Valdieri and back to Cuneo via Borgo San Dalmazzo.
la-fausto-coppi.note: Granfondo in late June from Cuneo; in 2026 on the same course as in 2025. The Maira side of the Esischie is narrow and rough; the Fauniera and the Sampeyre are usually open until mid-October.

la-marmotte.description: Bourg d'Oisans – Glandon – Télégraphe – Galibier – Lautaret – Alpe d'Huez.
la-marmotte.note: The Galibier sets the window; event in early July.

les-3-ballons.description: From Ronchamp via Plancher-les-Mines over the Ballon de Servance to Le Thillot, via Cornimont and Ventron over the Col d'Oderen to Kruth, from Wildenstein up to the Markstein and along the Route des Crêtes to the Grand Ballon, down the Thur valley and over the Col du Hundsruck to Masevaux, from Sewen up the Ballon d'Alsace and down to Giromagny, finishing on the Planche des Belles Filles.
les-3-ballons.note: Event in early June from Ronchamp, finishing on the Planche des Belles Filles; on the Ballon d'Alsace the course rides only the flank from Sewen, not up to the col.

lombardia-runde.description: The finale of the Giro di Lombardia from Bellagio: over the Ghisallo to Asso, through Sormano over the Muro up to the Colma and along the lake via Nesso back to Bellagio.
lombardia-runde.note: Occasional snow on the Sormano in winter.

maratona-dles-dolomites-lang.description: Sellaronda plus Campolongo (twice), Giau, Falzarego and Valparola from La Villa.
maratona-dles-dolomites-lang.note: Event in early July; the passes are closed on the day.

marcialonga-cycling-craft.description: From Predazzo via Moena to Sèn Jan di Fassa and over the Costalunga, down past the Lago di Carezza and Nova Levante to Ponte Nova, up via Obereggen to the Passo Pampeago and down to Tesero, then from Moena over the San Pellegrino and the steep Passo Valles and back to Predazzo through the forest of Paneveggio.
marcialonga-cycling-craft.note: Granfondo in late May, early for the Costalunga, San Pellegrino and Valles; the stretch from Obereggen over the Pampeago is closed to cars.

melogno-scravaion-runde.description: From Finale Ligure via Finalborgo up to the Colle del Melogno, through Calizzano and Bardineto to the Colle Scravaion and back along the coast via Castelvecchio and Albenga.
melogno-scravaion-runde.note: Briefly closed after snowfall on the Melogno.

oberalp-lukmanier-gotthard-runde.description: From Andermatt over the Oberalp to Disentis, over the Lukmanier into the Blenio valley to Biasca, up the Leventina to Airolo and back to Andermatt over the Gotthard.
oberalp-lukmanier-gotthard-runde.note: Over the Gotthard either on the cobbled Tremola or on the main road.

oetztaler-radmarathon.description: Sölden – Kühtai – Innsbruck – Brenner – Jaufenpass – Timmelsjoch – Sölden.
oetztaler-radmarathon.note: Event in late August; the Timmelsjoch toll is free for bikes.

penser-joch-jaufen-runde.description: From Merano down the Adige valley to Bolzano, through the Sarntal up the Penser Joch, down to Sterzing, over the Jaufen Pass into the Passeier valley and back to Merano via St. Leonhard.
penser-joch-jaufen-runde.note: The lower Sarntal has long tunnels that are open to bicycles.

riviera-dei-fiori-runde.description: From Imperia over the Colle San Bartolomeo to Pieve di Teco, through Rezzo up to the Colle d'Oggia and back to the coast via Carpasio and the Argentina valley – the winter loop of the Sanremo pros.
riviera-dei-fiori-runde.note: Occasional snow at the top of the Oggia in January and February.

route-des-grandes-alpes.description: Thonon-les-Bains to Menton over 17 passes, typically 6–8 stages.
route-des-grandes-alpes.note: The Iseran sets the window; in October only with a plan B over the Mont Cenis.

sellaronda.description: Classic Dolomites loop around the Sella massif from Corvara, clockwise.
sellaronda.note: Car-free Sellaronda Bike Day in June and in September.

sportful-dolomiti-race.description: From Feltre via Sospirolo through the Valle del Mis over the Forcella Franche to Agordo, up the Cordevole to Alleghe and from Selva di Cadore over the Staulanza into the Val di Zoldo, back over the Passo Duran to Agordo, over the Forcella Aurine and the Passo Cereda into the Primiero and from the Cismon valley over the Croce d'Aune back to Feltre.
sportful-dolomiti-race.note: Granfondo in mid-June from Feltre over the quiet passes of the Belluno Dolomites. Course unchanged since 2025.

stelvio-santini.description: From Bormio down the Valtellina to Grosio, up the short steep ramp to Rogorbello above Vervio, from Lovero and Sernio up onto the Mortirolo ridge and over the pass, down towards Grosio and back up the valley to Bormio, finishing on the Stelvio.
stelvio-santini.note: Event in early June finishing on the Stelvio; the Mortirolo from Lovero and Sernio along the ridge. Course unchanged since 2024.

stilfserjoch-umbrail-runde.description: Prad – Stilfserjoch (48 hairpins) – Umbrail – Santa Maria – Glurns – Prad.
stilfserjoch-umbrail-runde.note: Car-free Stelvio Bike Day in late August or early September.

stoneman-dolomiti-road.description: From Sexten via Toblach and Cimabanche to Cortina, up the Falzarego, via Colle Santa Lucia up the Giau, back to Cortina and over Tre Croci to Misurina, out and back up to the Auronzo hut beneath the Three Peaks, down to Auronzo, over the Passo Sant'Antonio to Padola and back to Sexten over the Kreuzberg.
stoneman-dolomiti-road.note: A signposted permanent route with stamp points and a starter pack; gold in one day, silver in two, bronze in three. The spur to the Auronzo hut is a toll road, and its season sets the window.

tour-du-mont-blanc-cyclo.description: From Les Saisies via Megève and Chamonix, over the Montets and the Forclaz to Martigny, up to Champex, over the Great St Bernard to Aosta, over the Little St Bernard to Bourg-Saint-Maurice and back to Les Saisies over the Cormet de Roselend – once round Mont Blanc in a day.
tour-du-mont-blanc-cyclo.note: Event in mid-July, solo or as a pair; an ultra, starting around 5 am. The course comes from secondary sources; the organiser's page could not be reached.

valcava-culmine-runde.description: From Lecco via Torre de' Busi steeply up to the Passo di Valcava, through the Valle Imagna and the Val Taleggio to the Culmine di San Pietro and back to Lecco via Moggio and the Valsassina.
valcava-culmine-runde.note: Both passes lie under snow at the top in winter.

ventoux-runde.description: From Bédoin up the classic side of the Mont Ventoux, down to Malaucène and back to Bédoin over the Col de la Madeleine.
ventoux-runde.note: The loop works as long as the Ventoux summit road is open.

vercors-cols-runde.description: From Saint-Jean-en-Royans up to Léoncel and the Col de la Bataille, over the Col de la Portette to Lente and the Col de la Machine, and down through the Combe Laval back to Saint-Jean.
vercors-cols-runde.note: After the Drôme department's leaflet; the Combe Laval has eleven tunnels.

vrsic-predil-runde.description: Kranjska Gora – Vršič – Soča valley – Bovec – Predil – Tarvisio – Kranjska Gora.
vrsic-predil-runde.note: The cobbles on the Vršič are slippery when wet.

schauinsland-notschrei-runde.description: From Freiburg-Günterstal up the old hill-climb course to the Schauinsland, across Hofsgrund to the Notschrei, down the Brugga valley to Oberried and back via Kirchzarten.
schauinsland-notschrei-runde.note: Many motorbikes on the Schauinsland at weekends; start early.

ruhestein-kniebis-runde.description: From Baiersbronn up the Obertal to the Ruhestein, along the Black Forest High Road past the Schliffkopf and the Zuflucht to the Kniebis, and back to Baiersbronn via Freudenstadt.
ruhestein-kniebis-runde.note: The Black Forest High Road between Ruhestein and Kniebis is a motorbike route at weekends.

femenia-lluc-runde.description: From Port de Pollença via Pollença and the Coll de Femenia to Lluc, over the Coll de sa Batalla down to Caimari and back across the plain via Campanet.
femenia-lluc-runde.note: In spring the loop half of Port de Pollença rides; Sa Calobra can be added from Lluc as a detour.

tour-du-sancy.description: From Le Mont-Dore over the Croix Saint-Robert down to Besse, past the Lac Chambon and back over the Croix-Morand to Le Mont-Dore.
tour-du-sancy.note: Super-Besse can be added as a detour from Besse (+12 km, +300 m).

osterzgebirge-runde.description: From Altenberg via Zinnwald to Cínovec, down the old border road to Dubí, through Krupka and up the hairpins to Komáří vížka, then along the ridge via Fojtovice back to Altenberg.
osterzgebirge-runde.note: The climb to Komáří vížka, close to 9 % on average, is the hardest of the loop; the old border road to Cínovec has been quiet since the D8 motorway opened.

dlouha-louka-runde.description: From Teplice to Osek, up the hairpins to Dlouhá Louka, along the ridge via Moldava to Cínovec and down the old border road via Dubí back to Teplice.
dlouha-louka-runde.note: Two ridge climbs out of the North Bohemian basin in one morning; between Dlouhá Louka and Cínovec the road stays up on the ridge.

kandel-runde.description: From Waldkirch in the Elz valley up the Kandel, across the plateau to St. Peter, down the Glottertal and via Denzlingen back to Waldkirch.
kandel-runde.note: The Kandel from Waldkirch is one of the hardest climbs in the Black Forest; the descent via St. Peter and the Glottertal is wide and well surfaced.

wiedener-eck-notschrei-runde.description: From Münstertal over the Wiedener Eck to Utzenfeld, through the Wiese valley to Todtnau, over the Notschrei down to Oberried and back via Kirchzarten, Sölden and Staufen to Münstertal.
wiedener-eck-notschrei-runde.note: The Schauinsland can replace the Notschrei descent from Oberried: up via Hofsgrund and down to Freiburg.

torfhaus-runde.description: From Bad Harzburg up the B4 to Torfhaus, across the plateau down to Altenau, via Schulenberg through the Oker valley to Oker and back to Bad Harzburg.
torfhaus-runde.note: The B4 up carries heavy traffic and motorbikes, so start early at weekends; the way back through the Oker valley is quieter.

arber-runde.description: From Bodenmais up to Bretterschachten, past the Großer Arbersee to the Brennes, down to Bayerisch Eisenstein and via Zwiesel back to Bodenmais.
arber-runde.note: The two highest road points of the Bavarian Forest in one day; busy with day-trippers at the Großer Arbersee and the Arber gondola in summer.

bavella-runde.description: From Zonza over the Col de Bavella down to Solenzara, along the coast via Sainte-Lucie to Porto-Vecchio and over the Ospedale plateau back to Zonza.
bavella-runde.note: The classic loop of the south; traffic on the T10 along the coast between Solenzara and Porto-Vecchio, free-roaming pigs up on the Bavella.

sevi-calanche-runde.description: From Evisa over the Col de Sevi to Vico, down to the Gulf of Sagone, along the coast via Cargèse to Piana, through the Calanche to Porto and up the Spelunca valley back to Evisa.
sevi-calanche-runde.note: The Calanche de Piana are a World Heritage site of red granite; the road through them is narrow and full of hire cars in summer, so go before ten.

soller-orient-runde.description: From Sóller over the Coll de Sóller to Bunyola, over the Coll d'Honor into the high valley of Orient, via Alaró and Santa Maria back to Bunyola and over the Coll de Sóller again to Sóller.
soller-orient-runde.note: The Coll de Sóller twice, both sides a ribbon of hairpins almost free of cars since the tunnel; in between the quiet high valley of Orient.

sa-calobra-runde.description: From Sóller up the Ma-10 to the Puig Major, on to the turn at the Coll dels Reis, down the hairpins to Sa Calobra and back the same way to Sóller.
sa-calobra-runde.note: Out and back on the same road: down to Sa Calobra first, then the nine kilometres back up. Coaches during the day, empty early in the morning.

teide-sud-runde.description: From Los Cristianos via Vilaflor up through the pine forest to the Boca de Tauce on the rim of the Cañadas, down across the lava fields to Chío and via Guía de Isora and Adeje back to the coast.
teide-sud-runde.note: Above 2,000 m the air is thin and it can be cold up there while it is summer on the coast; fill up with water in Vilaflor and Chío.

velefique-runde.description: From Tabernas through the desert to Velefique, up the hairpins onto the ridge of the Filabres, along the road towards Calar Alto and down to Gérgal, then back to Tabernas.
velefique-runde.note: There is no shade; from June to September only early in the morning. Fill up with water in Velefique and Gérgal.

lanciano-runde.description: From Guardiagrele to Pretoro, up through the beech forest to the Passo Lanciano and via Rapino back to Guardiagrele.
lanciano-runde.note: From the pass the road carries on to the Blockhaus (+9 km, +750 m), the Giro finish above the Majella.

piano-battaglia-runde.description: From Cefalù via Isnello up to Piano Battaglia, down to Petralia Sottana and via Castelbuono back to the coast at Cefalù.
piano-battaglia-runde.note: The big loop through the Madonie, with water in the mountain villages; in winter there can be snow on Piano Battaglia.

cobertoria-runde.description: From Pola de Lena over the Cobertoria to Quirós and into the Teverga valley, through the gorges of the Trubia to Proaza and via Morcín back to Pola de Lena.
cobertoria-runde.note: In the Vuelta the Cobertoria is often the prelude to the Angliru, which can be ridden from Pola de Lena as a ride of its own.

ardennen-runde.description: From Stavelot over the Côte de Stockeu towards Vielsalm, down to Trois-Ponts, over the Côte de Wanne back to Stavelot, over the Haute-Levée to Spa and over the Col du Rosier and La Gleize back to Stavelot.
ardennen-runde.note: The climbs of the Liège–Bastogne–Liège finale on one loop; short and steep, on narrow roads, slippery after rain.

riesengebirge-runde.description: From Špindlerův Mlýn up to the Špindlerova bouda, down the closed road to Przesieka, via Karpacz to Kowary, over the Okraj to Malá Úpa, via Pec pod Sněžkou and Janské Lázně to Vrchlabí and back to Špindlerův Mlýn.
riesengebirge-runde.note: From the Špindlerova bouda into Poland the road down is closed to cars, narrow and steep; bring an ID.

aspin-hourquette-runde.description: From Sainte-Marie-de-Campan via Payolle up the Col d'Aspin, down to Arreau, along the Aure valley to Ancizan, over the Hourquette d'Ancizan to Payolle and back to Sainte-Marie-de-Campan.
aspin-hourquette-runde.note: From Sainte-Marie-de-Campan the Tourmalet can be added as a detour to La Mongie or the pass.

soulor-spandelles-runde.description: From Argelès-Gazost through the Val d'Azun to Arrens, up the Col du Soulor, down the quiet Ouzom valley to Ferrières and over the Col de Spandelles back to Argelès-Gazost.
soulor-spandelles-runde.note: From the Soulor the Aubisque can be added via the Cirque du Litor (+16 km there and back, +350 m).

portillon-runde.description: From Bagnères-de-Luchon over the Col du Portillon to Bossòst, down the Garonne valley via Les to Saint-Béat and via Cierp-Gaud back to Bagnères-de-Luchon.
portillon-runde.note: The short loop from Luchon over the border; traffic towards Vielha down in the Garonne valley.

port-lers-runde.description: From Massat over the Col de Port to Tarascon-sur-Ariège, up the Vicdessos valley to Vicdessos, over the Port de Lers past the Étang de Lers and back to Massat.
port-lers-runde.note: At the Étang de Lers the Col d'Agnes can be added (+8 km there and back, +150 m).

ordino-runde.description: From Andorra la Vella via La Massana to Ordino, over the Coll d'Ordino to Canillo and via Encamp back to Andorra la Vella.
ordino-runde.note: Heavy traffic through Encamp and Andorra la Vella; the Coll d'Ordino itself is quiet.

marie-blanque-runde.description: From Laruns down the Ossau valley to Bielle, over the Col de Marie-Blanque down to Escot in the Aspe valley, to Oloron-Sainte-Marie and via Arudy back to Laruns.
marie-blanque-runde.note: The loop takes the Marie-Blanque from its easy side; for the last four kilometres at 11 %, ride it the other way round from Escot.

grand-colombier-runde.description: From Culoz up the hairpins of the east side to the Grand Colombier and via Anglefort back to Culoz.
grand-colombier-runde.note: Up from Culoz in hairpins with ramps above 10 %; the way down to Anglefort is the steepest side, narrow and irregular.

marchairuz-mollendruz-runde.description: From Le Brassus over the Col du Marchairuz down to Bière, via Mont-la-Ville up the Col du Mollendruz, down to L'Abbaye and along the Lac de Joux back to Le Brassus.
marchairuz-mollendruz-runde.note: The Mollendruz is cleared all year; the Marchairuz is often closed after snowfall in winter.

chasseral-runde.description: From Saint-Imier up the Chasseral, down to Nods, via Orvin to Sonceboz, via Tramelan up the Mont-Crosin and back to Saint-Imier.
chasseral-runde.note: The Chasseral road is closed in winter; then the Mont-Crosin is left on its own.

faucille-givrine-runde.description: From Gex up the hairpins to the Col de la Faucille, down to Mijoux, via Les Rousses to the Col de la Givrine, down via Saint-Cergue to Nyon and along the lake via Coppet and Divonne back to Gex.
faucille-givrine-runde.note: Traffic on the lake road and through the suburbs between Nyon and Divonne; the two passes are quieter.

oberhof-runde.description: From Zella-Mehlis up to Oberhof, down the north side of the Thuringian Forest to Tambach-Dietharz, via Floh-Seligenthal to Steinbach-Hallenberg and back to Zella-Mehlis.
oberhof-runde.note: Wide roads and steady gradients; at Oberhof the loop crosses the Rennsteig trail, and to the north it drops long and gently.

fataga-runde.description: From Maspalomas up through the Fataga gorge to San Bartolomé de Tirajana, via Santa Lucía de Tirajana down to Agüimes and along the coast via Vecindario back to Maspalomas.
fataga-runde.note: From Maspalomas through the Fataga gorge into the highlands; fill up with water in San Bartolomé and Santa Lucía.
